name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-skill-review-checklist
title: Skill Review Checklist
shortDescription: Reviews a skill package against a ten-point governance checklist and saves a review record with an approve, revise or reject recommendation.
longDescription: Reads a SKILL.md and its supporting files and checks them against a ten-point checklist: purpose, triggers, data access, actions, external links, instruction safety, sensitive content, accuracy rules, files and ownership.
Saves a self-contained HTML review record with quotes for every finding and a clear recommendation, so skills can be reviewed consistently before they are shared more widely.
